scheduleDesc: a tiered cron schedule (5m burst / 15m steady)
introText:
Your job is to read each unseen supplier-quote email, extract the quote data with the same care a senior operator would in a terminal session, and load the resulting VQs to OT — or route to the right folder when you can't.

The quality bar is the terminal Claude session that loaded RFQ 1132932 (vq@/Processed UID 8372 — 73 VQs from a 7-image APAC bulk summary). Match it.
sectionsToKnow: **Email Types** (Type 1 single-vendor vs Type 2 bulk-summary — different Buyer field rules)
**Field Reference (VQ Mass Upload Template)** — required vs optional fields
**Packaging Field Values** (UPPERCASE lookup — `REEL` not `Reel`, `F-TUBE` not `TUBE`, `BULK` not `EACH`)
**COO vs Shipping Terms** (`EXW Israel` is NOT a COO — it's a pickup location)
**Alternate MPN handling** (vendor's MPN goes in `vendorNotes` first; the `mpn` field carries the customer's RFQ MPN — iDempiere will reject the line otherwise)
**Vendor Matching Strategy** (domain-based, not exact email; active vendors only)

image-processing.IMAGE_EXTRACT_TARGETS: MPN, qty, price, date code, COO, vendor info
image-processing.IMAGE_EXTRA_NOTES: The `--include-images` flag is REQUIRED for VQ — APAC brokers paste quote screenshots inline as PNGs. Prioritize images larger than ~10KB — small ones (1-6KB) are usually signature/logo noise. The 1132932 calibration email had image006.png (127KB) and image007.png (131KB) as the actual quote tables.

summaryCounters: processed=<N> load_vq=<N> rfqs_written=<N> vqs_written=<N> vqs_skipped=<N> vqs_failed=<N> forward_to_rfq_loading=<N> need_info_vendor=<N> clarify_vendor=<N> needs_vendor=<N> needs_review=<N> no_bid=<N> not_vq=<N> dup_skip=<N> outbound_pending=<N> errors=<N>
transientErrorExamples: loadBulkSummary throws, attachment unreadable, vendor lookup 5xx
knownLimitations: **no_bid currently breadcrumb-only.** shared/vq-writer.js filters `cost > 0 && qty > 0` so a 0/0 VQ row would be silently dropped. The no_bid action records the decision in the breadcrumb but does NOT write a "we asked, declined" VQ row. Deferred: writer needs a `noBid: true` opt that bypasses the cost/qty filter.

**Type 1 template engine NOT wired into the agent.** vq-parser/templates/*.js (velocity, chip1, j2-sourcing, semitech, akira-global, atlantic-semi) do template-based extraction for known vendor formats. Today the agent does LLM extraction for every Type 1 email. Templates would be faster for the 5-10% high-volume vendors — deferred to a follow-up where templates become a tool the agent calls by sender domain.
